facts.text: Under Section 194A amendments, the threshold for deducting tax at source on deposit interest for senior citizens was doubled to 100,000 INR per annum.

facts.text: Failure to accurately report fixed deposit interest income in annual tax returns exposes taxpayers to penalties under Section 271(1)(c) reaching up to 200 percent of the tax payable.
